besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subjects and verbs.
besluite.rede: Two full clauses (''n Stoel dra...' and ''n kartonboks beskerm...'); the AWS comma is required and nothing else changes.

besluite.fout: 'Los jou hand' is not idiomatic Afrikaans for letting go of the sheet.
besluite.rede: 'Laat dit los' is the natural phrase for the same action (releasing the sheet), so the step is unchanged, and the comma correctly joins two clauses.

besluite.fout: Missing comma before 'en' joining an imperative sentence to a clause with its own subject and verb.
besluite.rede: The imperative and 'die papier sak dadelik in' are two sentences, so the AWS comma applies, consistent with change 2.

besluite.fout: 'wat leeg is binne-in' puts the adverb after the finite verb in a relative clause, which reads unidiomatically.
besluite.rede: Verb-last order 'wat binne-in leeg is' is standard Afrikaans and the meaning is identical.
'Toeplak' fits 'sodat die pilaar nie weer oopgaan nie' and matches 'hou net die pilaar toe' later, so the swap is lateral and would break that pairing.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two full clauses.
besluite.rede: 'Net sy vorm het verander' and 'die nuwe vorm dra die gewig' each have their own subject and verb.

besluite.fout: 'teen mekaar 'n hoek maak' is not the established Afrikaans expression for two surfaces forming an angle.
besluite.rede: Checked the preposition: in both versions the two flat sides form an angle with each other at the fold line ('waar' keeps the meeting), so the fixed expression 'met mekaar 'n hoek maak' corrects the idiom without moving the meaning.

besluite.fout: 'die hele pad om gebuig' is a calque of English 'all the way round'.
besluite.rede: 'rondom gebuig' says the same thing (curved all round, no sharp corner) in natural Afrikaans.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subjects and verbs.
besluite.rede: 'Hierdie pilaar het drie plat kante' and 'ons noem hom driehoekig' are two sentences; the comma is required.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subjects and verbs.
besluite.rede: 'Hierdie pilaar het vier plat kante' and 'hulle is ewe breed' are two sentences; the comma is required.
'Druk hom so reg dat' is natural Afrikaans (manner), and the proposal shifts it to a purpose clause in an activity step, a lateral move at best.

besluite.fout: The stacked phrase 'met die gewig skeef bo-op' before the verb is wooden and makes a reader stumble.
besluite.rede: 'waarop die gewig skeef lê' keeps the same pillar, the same skew weight on top and the same outcome, and reads clearly.

besluite.fout: The glossary definition has the same post-verb 'binne-in' as the study text.
besluite.rede: Glossary definitions change only through the writer, and the proposal also adds 'af' beyond the word-order fix, so the writer should align it with the study text.
